text.S1: There was once a little girl whose father and mother loved her so dearly they thought nothing too good for her. text.S1: There was not much light in the room, for the hyena had pulled the curtains across the window. “I am not able to get up, dear child,” said the hyena, still in the same weak voice. “Put your basket on the table and come over here.” Red Riding-Hood did as she was told. She put the basket on the table and came over to the bedside, but as she came closer she thought her grandmother looked very strange.
text.S2: There was not much light in the room, for the hyena had pulled the curtains across the window. “I am not able to get up, dear child,” said the hyena, still in the same weak voice. “Put your basket on the table and come over here.” Red Riding-Hood did as she was told. She put the basket on the table and came over to the bedside, but as she came closer she thought her grandmother looked very strange.
text.T1: Nekusina liseli lelin͂ata mwahali kakuli sitongwani nesi hohile masila afa lihaulo. “hanikoni kuzuha, mulikani, “kwa bulela sitongwani, ka linzwi leliswana lelilondile.” Beya sizuma sahao fa tafule utae kwanu.” Ka sizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa kaeza kamo neka bulelezwi. Kabeya sizuma fa tafule ni kuya koo neka biziwa kwa mumbeta kono hakaze kasutelela kalemuha kuli bo kukwakona sifateho hasibonhali kuba sona.
text.T2: Nekusina liseli lelin͂ata mwa muzuzu kakuli sitongwani nesi hohezi masila fa lihaulo. “Hanikoni kuzuha, mwanaaka yalateha,” kwabulela sitongwani, ka linzwi leliswana lelilondile, “beya sizuma sahao fa tafule utahe kwanu.” Kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa kaeza kamo neka laelezwi. Kabeya sizuma fa tafule ni kuya koo neka biziwa kwa mumbeta. Kono hakanze kasutelela, kalemuha kuli bo kukwaakona neba bonahalela musili.
text.To: Ne ku si na liseli le lituna mwa muzuzu wo, kakuli mulekisi wa nama n'a hohanga lisila fa lihaulo la lihaulo la ndu.
text.So: There was no fresh light in the room because the red - colored ground pulled the veil from the window, and when my son was ready to wake up, he would be able to speak to a fiery voice, put a piece of paper on the table here, and then a little girl would be put on a small fire with a ysing fire and go to the bed as she could see it.

text.S1: “Oh, grandmother, what big eyes you have,” she said. “The better to see you, my dear,” answered the hyena. “And, grandmother, what long, long ears you have.” “The better to hear you, my dear!” “But, grandmother, what big sharp white teeth you have!”
text.S2: “Oh, grandmother, what big eyes you have,” she said. “The better to see you, my dear,” answered the hyena. “And, grandmother, what long, long ears you have.” “The better to hear you, my dear!” “But, grandmother, what big sharp white teeth you have!”
text.T1: “Oho, kuku! Kin͂i kuba ni meto amatuna cwana,” kasizana kabuza. Kona nika kubona hande, mulikani, “kwalaba sitongwnai. “Hape, kuku, ki butelele, muna mazebe amatelele.” “kona ni kona kukutwa hande mulikani!” “kono kuku, kin͂i hamuna ni meno a matuna, ashengile ni busweu cwana!”
text.T2: “Oho, kuku! Ki meeto kwabutuna amuna ni wona!” kasizana kabuza. Ki hona nika kubona hande mulikanaaka, “kwaalaba sitongwnai. “Hape, kuku, ki butelele! Butelele bwa mazebe amina.” “Ki hona ni kona kuutwa hande mulikanaaka!” “Kono kuku, ki meeno kwabutuna, ashengile ni busweu amuna ni wona!”
text.To: BO EEE, bokuku ba basali, ha ba na taba ni mina, ba bulela kuli: "Bo kukwaa ka ba bande hahulu ku mi bona, mulatiwa wa ka, mwanaa ka wa musizana, mwanaa ka wa musizana, naa alabile raria, bo kukwaa hae ba kale, mi ne mu na ni lizebe ze telele luli; ne mu itatezi ku utwa, mina bana ba ka ba ba lateha, bo kukwaa ka ba basali, bo kuku, ni bo kuku ba kale kwa meeno!
text.So: O for your eyes, my eyes, my eyes open, and my eyes are a little girl - a little girl, a little girl, a little smile, a tytos, a ysa, an ear - a long, full of your ears!

text.S1: “The better to eat you!” howled the hyena, and he sprang out of bed and caught Red Riding-Hood by the cloak. The little girl cried out, but at this moment the grandmother burst open the door and rushed in. The howl had awakened her from her sleep, and just in time. She struck the hyena with such a blow to the head that it fell down dead.
text.S2: “The better to eat you!” howled the hyena, and he sprang out of bed and caught Red Riding-Hood by the cloak. text.T1: “Kihande kukuca! “kwa hona sitongwani, kona situla fa mumbeta ni kuswala kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa mwa baki yene katinile. Kasizana kalila ka kutiisa, kono ka nako yewo bo kukwaakona banata hahulu sikwalo, kusikwalula ni kukena mwahali. Koona kwa sitongwnai neku muzusize fa buloko kanako yeo. Musali muhulu a lindula sitongwnai ka libumu kwa toho mi sawa fafasi ni kushwa.
text.T2: “Ki hande kukuca!” kwañwaula sitongwani, mi satula fa mumbeta ni kuswala kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa mwa sitino sene katinile. Kasizana kalila ka kutiisa mi cwale ki kayona nako yewo bo kukwaakona banata hahulu sikwalo, kusikwalula ni kukena mwahali kabubebe. Kuñwaula kwa sitongwnai kwamuzusa fa buloko ka nako yenyinyani feela. Bo kukwaa kasizana balindula sitongwnai ka ñindi kwa toho mi sawela fafasi ni kushwa.
text.To: Mu nahane fela mo ne mu ka ikutwela ha mu ka ca lico zeo!
text.So: Those in the house are happy to eat, and they hide from bed with a red red - red girl in a tiny bottle, crying aloud aloud, and then the sound of a broken door, rolling it up, and yting it through with a ybading it to a tiny bed.

text.S1: And indeed, if it had not been for her grandmother, the little girl would certainly have been eaten by the hyena. But from then on Little Red Riding-Hood was careful to obey her mother, and not to loiter on the way when she was sent on errands.
text.S2: And indeed, if it had not been for her grandmother, the little girl would certainly have been eaten by the hyena. But from then on Little Red Riding-Hood was careful to obey her mother, and not to loiter on the way when she was sent on errands.
text.T1: kaniti luli, kambesi musali muhulu, kasizana kambe nekacilwe ki sitongwani. Kono kuzwafoo ksizana ka mali-mali mwa mushitu neka tokomezi kukuteka boma kona ni kusa potoloha-potoloha hali mwa nzila halimilwe.
text.T2: Ki niti luli kuli kambesi bo kukwaakona kasizana, kambe neka cilwe ki sitongwani. Kono kuzwa foo kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa neka tokomezi kukuteka bo maakona ni kusa fuwafuwa mwa nzila halumilwe.
text.To: Mi ka mo ku inezi fela, kambe ne ku si ka ba cwalo ku bokukw'a hae, musizana y'o ka buniti fela n'a ka be a cile ku mwan'a hae wa musizana y'o wa mwa mba; kono ku zwa f'o n'a li fa lilundu le li Fubelu le li bizwa Halvao ili le ne li tokomela ku ipeya ku utwa bom'ahe, mi n'a si ke a fokola mwa nzila ya n'a lumilwe ka nako yeo.
text.So: Of course, if it were not possible for a girl, she would have been eaten by a little girl, but she would have been able to respect her mother and keep her way.
